# Original upload helper

`uploader.exe` is the unchanged Farever Group DPS / Farever Logs uploader supplied
for this port. Its original authors retain ownership. It is not an HLX component
and this repository does not claim to contain its source or grant a new license
for it. The collector and game UI are implemented in the Haxe source directory.

- Size: 380416 bytes
- SHA-256: `a43f20e5e7014d7a6d18952a60b89515bd87c30fe99420cac1d753d7b8b03b33`
- Default endpoint: `https://fareverlogs.fr/api/v1/runs`
- Original user agent: `farever-group-dps-uploader/1.0`

Packaging verifies this hash. No `dinput8.dll`, uploaded personal log, or game
binary is included.
